title: I'm not a designer, so I ran an AI design council
dek: Six rounds of AI critique on real renders, and the one call I made against the critics.
description: I'm not a designer. AI critics (LLM-as-judge) scored six rounds of real renders of my voice assistant's avatar in one evening, and I made the final call.
ogTitle: The AI critics never signed off on her jaw. I shipped anyway.
